steps.title: When the hero walks in
steps.body: on("enterZone", { zone: … }, …) runs when the hero enters a trigger zone. The { zone: "zn_…" } part says which zone — your pond's id is filled in for you here.
steps.task: Add an enterZone block for the pond.
steps.tip: Every zone, asset and screen has an id; the inspector shows it.

steps.title: When the hero uses the chest
steps.body: on("interact", { asset: … }, …) runs when the hero presses E at an asset (any copy of it). Here it adds a coin and plays a sound with audio.playSound.
steps.task: Add an interact block for the chest.

steps.title: When a variable changes
steps.body: on("varChanged", { var: "coins" }, …) runs every time coins changes — from code, a zone action, a screen button or a cinematic. log(vars.coins) prints the new value.
steps.task: Add a varChanged block for coins.

steps.title: Every few seconds
steps.body: on("timer", { seconds: 5, repeat: true }, …) runs 5 seconds after play starts, and again every 5 seconds when repeat is true.

steps.title: Your own events
steps.body: emit("name") sends an event anywhere in the game; on("custom", { event: "name" }, …) hears it. Assets, zones, screens and cinematics can send events too, so this is how parts of a game talk to each other.
steps.task: Add a custom block for the event rich.
steps.tip: Other events: smash, rebuildFinished, cinematicDone, screenButton, exitZone.
